test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: A judge of a high court can be removed from the office before the expiry of tenure by the _______

options.text: President on the recommendation of the supreme court.
Governor on the recommendations of the state legislations
President on the recommendation of the state legislature
President on the recommendation of the Parliament

solution:
The correct answer is __**President on the recommendation of the Parliament**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The President** on the resolution of parliament passed by a** special majority**.

 
 
• A Judge of the Supreme Court (and also the High Court) can be removed from his position by President only on the ground of proven misbehavior or incapacity.
 
• The power for investigation and proof of such misbehavior or incapacity is vested in the parliament.
 
• Each house, in order to remove the judge, will have to pass a resolution, which is supported by 2/3rd of members present and voting and the majority of the total membership of the house {absolute + special majority}.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Supreme Court** is mentioned in **Article 124 **of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Judges of the Supreme Court and High Court are appointed by the President of India.
 
• Provisions of High courts are mentioned in** Articles 214-231** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The salary and allowances of judges of the Supreme Court and High Court are determined by the Paliament of India according to **Article 125 and Article 221 respectively**.
